Water is good for the body.
боліти: to feel pain; to cause pain
голова: the top part of the body
зуб (мн. teeth): a hard white thing in your mouth (plural: teeth)
ліки: pills or liquid you take when you are ill
нога: the part of your body you walk on
палець (на руці): one of the five parts at the end of your hand
рот: you eat and speak with it
рука (від плеча до кисті): the part of your body from the shoulder to the hand
рука (кисть): the part at the end of your arm, with fingers
спина: the part of your body behind you
стопа (мн. feet): the part at the end of your leg (plural: feet)
температура: how hot your body is; a fever
тіло: all of a person: head, arms, legs…
